lead: A dropdown select. The trigger looks like Input; the keyboard, type-ahead search and collision flipping come from Base UI's Select.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `select.css`: the trigger reuses the input's look, the popup reuses Menu's item look.
styling.trigger: The trigger, looks like Input; `data-popup-open` while open
styling.value: Shows the selected text; `data-placeholder` when there is no value
styling.icon: The dropdown arrow on the right
styling.popup: The popup and the option list
